reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.

The cited text supports compliance: §9(b) contains affirmative express warranties covering performance to industry standards (p0034), services free from material errors (p0038), no malicious code (p0036) and ongoing compliance with Laws (p0041) — the walk-away 'AS IS with all warranties disclaimed' scenario is absent.

Duration analysis is sound: the warranties run 'now and throughout the Term' with a one-year Initial Term auto-renewing (p0016), so the effective warranty window meets or exceeds the 12-month/90-day benchmark; the deterministic period check also passes.

The §13 disclaimer is properly carved back ('Except as expressly set forth herein' and 'except for the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement'), so it does not swallow the express warranties.

Correct application of the no-flagging-favourable-terms principle on remedy: absent any sole/exclusive-remedy language, Customer retains all remedies at law, and inserting the model repair/replace/refund election at Vendor's option would be a downgrade.

Shortfalls short of preferred wording (conformance to industry standards rather than documentation, no 'professional and workmanlike' formulation) are correctly noted in the rationale rather than redlined.
